payload.description: How many licence applications Norwich decides in a year, and how many it turns down. The officer's report to the March 2026 committee counts the licences in force but not the decisions behind them, and the council publishes no annual licensing report. The Home Office does publish a per-authority table each year covering applications, refusals and reviews, but it is a national spreadsheet of every licensing authority and we have not brought it into the archive, so we are not quoting figures from it here.
